description: This file defines a React component for an export page in a manufacturing defect management system. It provides UI for selecting date ranges and downloading defect data as CSV or PDF files from backend endpoints.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a file from the specified URL with optional authorization, then triggers download in the browser.

methods.name: ExportPage
methods.description: React functional component rendering the export interface with date selection and download buttons.
